notes.title: Update News: VR TOON New Languages Added!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 
VR TOON <Help Me> is now available in Korean, English and [b]Chinese[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33196208/5ca976f0bed14f12016269bc2c224bee56694e16.jpg[/img]

In this update:

• Support for Chinese
• Improved lighting
• Various minor bug fixes

We will continue to concentrate more on improving VR contents play. If you have any further questions do not hesitate to ask us. We will try to answer your questions in detail. 

Dexter Studios.
